title: AC1024 associative network DXF record writer slice
scope: Add a source-bound DXF record writer for the independently witnessed AC1024 ACDBASSOCNETWORK profile. This is a record primitive only: do not route it through the complete DWG-to-DXF graph or relax the existing strict graph refusal.

independentWitness.observed: The handle-2493 AC1024 source object and peer DXF agree on the owner, reactor, AcDbAssocAction fields, distinct base/network indexes, three owned action references, and empty additional-owned-action list. The peer DXF encodes those action references as group 360.

implementationBrief.writerProfile: AC1024 ACDBASSOCNETWORK; require complete AcDbAssocAction and AcDbAssocNetwork prefix statuses; require the witnessed class/network versions, null action body and empty dependency, parameter and additional-owned-action portions; retain owner, reactors and extdata; remap self, owner, owning-network, reactor and action handles; select group 360 for owned actions and 330 for soft actions.
implementationBrief.profileLimits: This exact source-backed record profile rejects generic APPDATA, extension-dictionary handles, nonzero action-body handles, nonzero network version, dependency/value-parameter bodies and additional owned-action lists until their field/reference roles are independently qualified. It does not claim graph closure or adapter routing.
implementationBrief.transaction: Use RecordStateScope and DxfWriterRecordScope. Late failure must leave no record bytes or identity binding; a corrected retry on the same object must succeed.
implementationBrief.validation: Generated in-memory ASCII and Binary numeric-wire projections for the independent source record with remapped self/owner/reactor/network/action handles; exercise owned and soft action handle codes, incomplete and unsupported profiles, unresolved-reference rollback, late EED failure and corrected retry. Keep the strict whole-graph export refusal active.
implementationBrief.fixturePolicy: No external DWG or DXF fixture files; generate test records in memory.

implementation.summary: Added writeAssociativeNetwork as a direct AC1024-only record primitive. It requires both completed parsed-prefix statuses, binds and remaps the source identity transactionally, emits reactor/owner/base-action/network fields in source order, maps action ownership to group 330/360, and retains XDATA. It is not routed through dx_iface or whole-document output.
implementation.generatedCoverage: In-memory source-matched handle-2493 projection in ASCII and Binary with remapped self/owner/reactor/network/action identities; all-owned source action list plus a mixed ownership check; extended data; unsupported versions and incomplete profiles; unresolved reactor, owning-network and action references each roll back identity and bytes; late malformed EED rollback and corrected same-object retry.
implementation.strictExport: No adapter route was enabled; complete-document associative export remains refused.

physicalSourceStrictGate.result: Expected dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized refusal remains active; no DXF was published.

remainingP4Scope: Integrate the dependency and network record writers into an admitted associative graph planner; establish source/planned/emitted identity, emit audited constraint nodes, close required descendants, verify staged output independently and by readback, and retain whole-graph refusal until closure is proven.
nextAction: Route the existing AC1024 dependency and new network record writers through the source-bound graph planner. Keep full-document refusal active until required descendants are closed and staged output is independently inspected and read back.
supportClaimEffectReason: An exact local record serializer and independent field projection do not establish complete associative graph conversion, consumer semantics or support qualification.
